mentions.name: NetSuite competitor ERP
mentions.description: An ERP system built as a direct competitor to NetSuite, covering accounting and inventory, with AI used to accelerate development progress.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a direct competitor to Netsuite. I’ve worked on ERPs, accounting, and inventory long enough to think I can do it. And with AI I can make progress on this in a way that would have been unfathomable a year ago.
